mountPath.description:
The name of the root directory used to project Downward API information into the container. It is declared
in the pod metadata as volumeMount.mountPath for the volume projecting the downward API. Conventionally
"/etc/podinfo". No check is performed when the constructor is evaluated, only when the instance is queried.

title:
Strongly typed access to information about our pod and container exposed via Kubernetes Downward API. This is how
a C3 node get information about its own Kubernetes environment. When individual pieces of information are projected
with the Downward API, we expect that their path relative to the mount point matches the manifest YAML structure.
For example, we expect a pod's name to be projected as a <mountPath>/metadata/name file.
For a full list of exposed items, see the get methods. More can be added.
name: K8sDownwardApiAccess
